reconciliation_pixel_vs_slide_level.conclusion: The 25-slide per-slide secondary-mismatch deltas (mask area% vs model area% at the mask's called grade) are the per-slide expression of this same pixel-level bias, not a separate effect. The dominant driver matches almost exactly: true_G3-to-G4 leakage alone supplies 26.0% of the model's entire predicted-G4 pool at a 2.06x rate vs the reverse (G4-to-G3), consistent with the 1.93x seen in-domain. A secondary, steeper contributor compounds it: true_G5 pixels leak into pred_G4 far more than into pred_G3 (17.3x asymmetry), which is why deltas on G5-adjacent slides (5+4/4+5 patterns) can run larger than a naive G3<->G4-only estimate would predict. Both mechanisms point the same direction (toward more predicted G4), so this is one coherent bias observed at two resolutions, not two separate phenomena.
